items.statement: Within the isolated-molecule computational boundary, the validated optimized structure and the displacement-assigned nitrate vibrational evidence support the paper's bidentate eta2-nitrato assignment; incomplete peak mapping and quantitative deviations from X-ray/KBr values must be reported as model limitations.
items.expected: Within the isolated-molecule computational boundary, the validated optimized structure and displacement-assigned nitrate evidence support the bidentate eta2-nitrato assignment; incomplete peak mapping and quantitative deviations from X-ray/KBr values must be reported rather than hidden.
